video_title: Andre Iguodala joins The Richard Show | NBA Finals 10-Year Reunion

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the natural tendency for former athletes to self-deprecate
quotes.excerpt: being a former athlete, self-deprecation is pretty natural.
quotes.quote: Being a former athlete, self-deprecation is pretty natural. So, I don't really care about the stuff on the court as much.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on being a self-taught shooter without proper player development
quotes.excerpt: I was a self-taught shooter, so I made a thousand threes without being the shooter.
quotes.quote: I was a self-taught shooter, so I made a thousand threes without being the shooter. I used the Kobe method where I just shot 500 makes a day. But the form piece, I was never equipped with the proper player development system.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the lack of access to proper training for young players
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know I probably should have went to a high school and got access to a gym.
quotes.quote: I didn't know I probably should have went to a high school and got access to a gym. I thought like, as I got older, I always got my reps up, but I didn't know I could have went to the gym at night.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on his pride in his defensive ability
quotes.excerpt: I was really good at defense. That's the only thing I would say I was really good at.
quotes.quote: I was really good at defense. That's the only thing I would say I was really good at. That's the thing that I will gloat about.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on his potential as an offensive player
quotes.excerpt: I missed out on my offensive potential.
quotes.quote: I missed out on my offensive potential.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on his role as a defensive anchor for teammates
quotes.excerpt: I help with the defense, me and Bogut help with the defense, we don't get credit for.
quotes.quote: I help with the defense, me and Bogut help with the defense, we don't get credit for. And then Klay gets to catch the ball on the seams, which is from me and Shaun Livingston.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of leadership and player relationships
quotes.excerpt: I think it's leadership. And not like leadership raw-raw being loud. I knew my teammates.
quotes.quote: I think it's leadership. And not like leadership raw-raw being loud. I knew my teammates. And so I had a relationship with all of them.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on his confidence during the 2015 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I'm the best player on the court. I didn't think I was going to miss every time I got the ball.
quotes.quote: I'm the best player on the court. I didn't think I was going to miss every time I got the ball. That's probably the highest confidence I've ever been. I had the highest level of respect for LeBron, but I had to tell myself, 'No, I'm better than him.'

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of values in team building
quotes.excerpt: We drive our value while we play. And then once you're done playing, they kick you in the ass.
quotes.quote: We drive our value while we play. And then once you're done playing, they kick you in the ass and shut the door.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of leadership in winning championships
quotes.excerpt: Hopefully, I can be that piece to get the team to where we all want to be.
quotes.quote: Hopefully, I can be that piece to get the team to where we all want to be, which is try to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the challenges of transitioning to life after basketball
quotes.excerpt: They say you die when you retire. Athletes die twice. We do die.
quotes.quote: They say you die when you retire. Athletes die twice. We do die. And so sometimes when I'm working on something else and I'm struggling because there's just not my first area of expertise and I'm still learning, I have to go remind myself like, 'Oh, I had a brain at one point that worked.'

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of team chemistry and player roles
quotes.excerpt: You got a great battle. This is a great battle.
quotes.quote: You got a great battle. This is a great battle. Klay Thompson, clouds. Andrew Bogut, mate. Kevin Durant, cheat-code. Draymond Green, savant.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the potential for teammates to become head coaches
quotes.excerpt: Draymond Green is most likely to turn the film session into philosophy.
quotes.quote: Draymond Green is most likely to turn the film session into philosophy.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of team culture and player development
quotes.excerpt: We would switch places with them any day of the week. They can have the fame.
quotes.quote: We would switch places with them any day of the week. They can have the fame. They can have pulling up to the club, getting a table, not having to get a reservation. You can have that.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the impact of team culture and player roles
quotes.excerpt: We give him so much credit for the 22 championship and he didn't play a minute.
quotes.quote: We give him so much credit for the 22 championship and he didn't play a minute. You may not have played in the playoffs. Chris Chiozza, he's different. Leandro Barbosa was sneaky funny.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of team chemistry and player relationships
quotes.excerpt: Allen Iverson is under the radar like a great investor.
quotes.quote: Allen Iverson is under the radar like a great investor.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of team values and player development
quotes.excerpt: We drive our value while we play.
quotes.quote: We drive our value while we play.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of team chemistry and player development
quotes.excerpt: Stephen Curry and I were actually teammates on the world championship team. His ankles weren't attached yet.
quotes.quote: Stephen Curry and I were actually teammates on the world championship team. His ankles weren't attached yet. They were still falling off the bone.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of team depth and player development
quotes.excerpt: We had Bogut, we had Livingston, Ezeli was coming into his own, Mo Speights, we called him Mo-Ville.
quotes.quote: We had Bogut, we had Livingston, Ezeli was coming into his own, Mo Speights, we called him Mo-Ville. He had a spot where he could score at any time. That's when you strengthen the numbers. Barbosa and Justin Holiday, we had a squad.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of team depth and player development
quotes.excerpt: We had Russ who plays like he's 6'8, then you had Roberson who's 6'8, KD at the three.
quotes.quote: We had Russ who plays like he's 6'8, then you had Roberson who's 6'8, KD at the three, he's 7 feet tall. Ibaka is 6'10 and then Steven Adams is the strongest human on earth. If you had like a crazy 20-point score off the bench, that gave us trouble sometimes and they had Dion Waiters who can just fill it up off the bench.
